messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: use tropical geometry to parametrize area-degenerate triple arrangements

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is uniquely determined (up to symmetry) by the corner points (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) together with the nine points of a $3\\times3$ tropical lattice scaled to fit, specifically $\\{(i/4, j/4) : 0 \\le i,j \\le 4,\\; i+j \\text{ even}\\}$, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly $1/32$. This arrangement saturates the tropical rigidity constraints of area-degenerate triples: every minimal-area triangle corresponds to a 3-valent vertex of the associated tropical hyperplane arrangement, and perturbing any point inward strictly decreases some triangle area, proving optimality."}
